raids.description: A walled bandit camp high on the ridge, guarded by two arrow towers.
A fortified camp with a hired hero on guard. Expect it to come out and fight.
A narrow camp that guards the road through the ridge.
Smoke hides the towers here until you are close.
The first true fortress. Its keeper holds an Awakening Scroll.
Raiders hide among the reeds at the edge of the hollow.
Magic towers light the only crossing.
Its guards know every path through the mist.
Thick walls, and a garrison that does not retreat.
The heart of the hollow. Its lord holds an Ascension Stone.
The climb begins, under fire the whole way.
Weapons for the peak are made here, and tested on visitors.
Veteran heroes hold the last wall before the summit.
Nothing passes the gate without a fight.
The final stronghold. Its master holds a Sovereign Scroll.
